title: New Zealand biogeographic subrealm mapped in QGIS
credit: Wikimedia contributor Z3lvs; Natural Earth and Resolve Ecoregions 2017 source data
altText: Thematic map showing the New Zealand biogeographic subrealm, ecosystem boundaries and surrounding ocean.
caption: QGIS map of the New Zealand biogeographic subrealm, produced in October 2025 using Natural Earth base data and published ecoregion boundaries.
context: A specific late-period ecological mapping product useful as a conservation GIS illustration; not evidence of the earlier Department of Conservation GIS platform.
